1.consolidated_definition: Pastel de harina de yuca que, relleno con carne de res, cerdo o cangrejo, se cuece en el horno envuelto en hoja de plátano.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Cassava flour cake filled with beef, pork, or crab meat, baked in the oven wrapped in banana leaf.
